findings.title: debug_ingest stage-4 bias re-derivation tails repeated cycle rows, false-failing on a real bundle
findings.claim: ingest compares the store-window bias to the last N cycle rows' accuracy_sample, but every row repeats the latest sample (192 tail rows = 78 distinct samples), so delta=0.115 C and bias-rederived fails; matched by sample t the delta is 0.000

perturbation.change: --perturb dedupe: rows deduplicated by sample t and store window restricted to them

findings.metric_definition: |store-window temperature_bias - rows-window temperature_bias| as gated by ingest stage 4 (< 0.05)
findings.phenomenon_property: a re-derivation over cycle_rows must key samples by their own t, not by row position
findings.proposed_fix_scope: dedupe row samples by t and compare on the shared window

findings.title: debug_ingest replay-clean passes vacuously when the replay half is null
findings.claim: stage 2 runs export.violations over bundle['replay'] or {} and passes on the empty dict; the live bundle's replay is null

perturbation.change: --perturb nonempty: violations on an empty replay returns a refusal

findings.metric_definition: 1 when replay-clean is ok and the bundle's replay half is empty
findings.phenomenon_property: a privacy check must fail, not pass, on an absent section
findings.proposed_fix_scope: refuse or mark skipped when replay is empty

findings.title: debug_ingest --bundle fails 6 of 12 stages on the download as handed (no data.debug unwrap)
findings.claim: the Download diagnostics file nests hpo-debug/1 under data.debug; ingest reads the top level, so schema/manifest/rows/stores/bias fail
findings.metric_definition: count of failed ingest stages on the unmodified download file
findings.phenomenon_property: bundle loaders must accept the download envelope

findings.title: export credential-named-key rule flags a boolean value
findings.claim: export._walk reports 'a credential-named key carries a value' for diagnostics.tibber_reauth_started=False, since False is not in (None,'',[],{})

perturbation.change: --perturb boolkey: credential-key rule skips bool values

findings.metric_definition: count of credential-named-key violations in export.violations over data.debug
findings.phenomenon_property: the credential-key rule must judge only value types that can carry a secret
findings.proposed_fix_scope: exempt bool from the credential-key rule

findings.title: store.DOMAINS omits writer fields pump_duty written/silent and snapshots learners peak_tracker
findings.claim: 25 stored leaves in the real stores have no declaration in store.DOMAINS (pump_arbiter _SLOTS writes 'silent'; snapshot learners carry peak_tracker); synthetic bundle shows 0

perturbation.change: --perturb declare: add written/silent/0,1 to pump_duty and alias snapshots/#/learners/peak_tracker to accuracy/peaks

findings.metric_definition: count of stored_fields leaves with domain None or outside in_domain, over every store document of the bundle
findings.phenomenon_property: every field a store writer persists has a DOMAINS declaration
findings.seam_rule: python: for each bundle store, store.stored_fields(_store_name(key), doc) with domain None
findings.proposed_fix_scope: declare the silent slot and peak_tracker learner in DOMAINS
